summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Policies & Procedures (P&P) section feature. All 13 test requirements passed successfully. The P&P section renders correctly with data-testid, appears only when user has 5+ completed steps, shows 0/6 progress initially, displays reassuring message, offers two path options (own policies vs $97 toolkit), has clickable 'Get the Toolkit' button that redirects to /templates?purchase=templates-bundle, shows all 6 policy categories with upload and mark-as-ready options, updates progress when marking categories complete, mentions Site Visit Readiness connection, and is expandable/collapsible.
passed_tests: Section appears when user has 5+ completed steps (tested with pp_test@example.com - 5 steps)
Section does NOT appear when user has less than 5 steps (tested with pp_test_few_steps@example.com - 3 steps)
Reassuring message 'No rush — work on this when you're ready' is visible when expanded
Two path options visible: 'Use Your Own Policies' and 'P&P Toolkit $97'
'Get the Toolkit' button is clickable with data-testid='purchase-pp-toolkit-btn'
All 6 policy categories present: Operations & Administration, Clinical & Service Delivery, HIPAA & Privacy, Client Rights & Grievances, Emergency & Safety, Compliance & Quality
Categories can be marked as ready via checkbox (tested marking Operations & Administration)
Categories have 'Upload file' option (6 upload links found)
Progress updates when marking categories complete (0/6 -> 1/6, 0% -> 17%)
Connection to Site Visit Readiness is mentioned: 'Your P&P progress connects to the Site Visit Readiness checklist'
Section is expandable/collapsible (tested expand and collapse)

few_steps_user.note: P&P section NOT visible (less than 5 steps)
